scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve eligibility to use the upcoming accessibility evidence studio for her own interactive storyboard by ensuring the required screen-reader run log can be produced beforehand.
Emerging Need: The lab VM activation voucher is absent, but it matters only after the studio format changes from possible instructor demo to learner-prototype review.
Decision Context: Stored design records identify the storyboard as interactive and still without the accepted log; saved notes define the VM-only evidence rule, voucher deadline, and limited disclosure route, while live notices resolve timing and channel.
Consequence: Timely handling leaves a feasible path to generate evidence before the studio, whereas the voucher batch seal makes activation arrive after the review.

parameter.subject: M4 accessibility studio format still pending
parameter.body: Monday's accessibility evidence studio may use instructor-provided demo files instead of learner prototypes. Please hold off on Assistive Technology Lab voucher requests until the format note is confirmed, because the lab is limiting activations this week.

parameter.title: M4 accessibility evidence studio
parameter.description: Accessibility evidence studio; whether learner prototypes will be audited live is still pending the program format note.

parameter.name: Continuing Ed Assistive Technology Lab
parameter.notes: Directory-verified contact for course-related assistive-technology VM activation vouchers.

parameter.subject: Confirmed: learner-prototype evidence review on Monday
parameter.body: The M4 studio is confirmed as a live learner-prototype screen-reader evidence review. Learners bringing scripted or interactive storyboards should arrive Monday with one exported run log tied to the current storyboard. Today's roster snapshot closes at 16:00 ET and is the last list the lab can use for Monday activation vouchers.

parameter.content: AT Lab voucher batch for Monday studios sealed at 16:00. New voucher requests after the seal will activate Tuesday afternoon at earliest and will not be usable for Monday 13:00 studio work.
